answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to post a work bond locked in escrow before trading: the bond is earned back slowly through verified honest work, like shale laid down layer by layer, and slashed in full the moment fraud is proven. One operator spinning up a gale of fake accounts must fund each bond separately, so attack cost scales with the number of fakes while honest agents pay once. A falcon-eyed audit trail — every deal signed and publicly checkable — makes fraud provable, so the bond is a trap, not a fee: fakes bleed money, honest agents keep theirs.
